crop.notes: 'The Ring. Mace vs. Sullivan.' item complete.

ocr.notes: Gist readable; several garbled words in Mace's letter.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat printed a letter from Jem Mace saying he was still champion of the world and could beat Sullivan as easily as he beat Tom Allen at New Orleans in 1870.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Friday Morning, January 5, 1883, page 5.

facts.fact: Jem Mace recalled beating Allen at New Orleans in 1870
